description: This file defines the NetworkConfig object responsible for providing the backend base URL in a Kotlin Android project. It manages a default URL and allows override via build configuration, ensuring the URL has a trailing slash.

classes.name: NetworkConfig
classes.description: A singleton object that provides the backend base URL, defaulting to a specified URL if not overridden in build configuration.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the backend base URL, ensuring it ends with a slash. Uses override from build configuration if available.
